# On-device AI: How it works and why it matters

On-device AI helps businesses enable real-time decision-making, improve privacy, and cut cloud-related costs. By running AI models directly on smartphones, wearables, edge devices, and other IoT hardware, organizations can analyze data locally and operate without relying on constant Internet access or cloud infrastructure.

This white paper breaks down the fundamentals of on-device AI, explores its business impact, and examines how leading companies are applying it in practice. It also details the enabling technologies, such as edge computing, computer vision, and 5G, that make real-time, device-level intelligence possible.
